task.title: Create a new Warehouse Request
task.shortdesc: Use this guide to create a new Warehouse Request.

ul.li: Required state: No warehouse request exists for entry number 10000.

context.p: The values below are examples from the automated UI test. Use values appropriate for your environment.

step.cmd: Choose the 🔍 icon, enter Warehouse Requests, and then choose the related link. Choose New to create a record.
In the Entry No. field, enter a value, for example 10000.

info.p: Specifies the number that identifies the warehouse request.

step.cmd: In the Description field, enter a value, for example Receive summer stock.

info.p: Specifies what the warehouse needs to do.

step.cmd: Close the Warehouse Requests page. Business Central saves your changes.

ul.li: The warehouse request is saved with the entered description.

link.linktext: Process an existing warehouse request from the request list
